question: Why is purification absent for the five vital winds in the described condition?
premises: The five vital winds are considered
Purification of them does not exist in this state
The condition is addressed to the best-faced one
inference: In the described impure condition, none of the five vital winds is purified
uncertainties: Internal sandhi in pañcānāmapi noted but token kept fused
plain_english: Best-faced one, there is no purification even of the five winds.
